visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People: Face/Hands]: A shirtless, muscular man with short dark hair stands center-frame, eyes closed, directly under a powerful vertical stream of water. His facial expression is serene as water douses his head and shoulders. [Objects: Details/State]: He wears light blue swim trunks with white floral patterns. The water creates a thick splashing mist around his feet. [Setting: Background/Lighting]: He is in a dimly lit, narrow rocky alcove with dark, wet, textured stone walls covered in mossy ferns. Lighting is natural but shadowed. (2) [People: Face/Hands]: A man wearing a brown t-shirt and black shorts walks up a stone staircase, followed by a woman in a black dress who is seen from a distance. [Objects: Details/State]: A brown road sign with white text points towards the waterfall. A smartphone screen is shown as an overlay displaying a map interface with a red pin. [Setting: Background/Lighting]: A brightly lit outdoor mountain trail surrounded by dense tropical foliage, palm-like leaves, and tall green trees under a clear, bright sky. (3) [People: Face/Hands]: The muscular man sits in a meditative cross-legged pose on a wooden pallet under the waterfall. A close-up shows his hands rapidly forming complex ritualistic finger-gestures (mudras). [Objects: Details/State]: The waterfall cascades from a high cliff edge about fifteen meters up. The wooden pallet is dark and wet. [Setting: Background/Lighting]: High-contrast outdoor scene with bright sunlight piercing through the top of the forest canopy, contrasting with the dark rocks below. (4) [People: Face/Hands]: Large crowds of pedestrians move through a narrow street. At the end, the muscular man stands by the rocks, smiling broadly at the camera while giving a clear thumbs-up gesture with his right hand. [Objects: Details/State]: A metal bowl on a table contains bubbling red soup, pieces of tofu, cabbage, and duck blood. [Setting: Background/Lighting]: Traditional red-brick architecture of an old commercial street under a bright blue sky with wispy white clouds.
